messages:
From: Jamie Liu <j.liu@quantify.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Demo request: Dedicated capacity for QuantifyAI — self signup

Hi Marissa,

I just completed the self-signup and booked a demo slot via your calendar for 11/24 10:00 AM PT. We're evaluating Redwood for a dedicated inference pool to drive our summarization pipeline. Key needs:

- Sustained 120 QPS during business hours
- 95th pct latency target < 120 ms for 512-token responses
- Ability to pin model versions and fast fallbacks

Can we include someone from your engineering/solutions team? I'd like to discuss workload shaping and an initial capacity estimate. I've attached a sample workload CSV (sample_workload.csv).

Thanks,
Jamie Liu
Head of ML
QuantifyAI

Attachment: sample_workload.csv (CSV, 120 KB)

Hi Jamie —

Thanks for the signup and for sharing the workload sample. Quick read-through looks helpful. I'd like to loop in our Solutions Engineer to make sure we size the pool correctly and cover latency gating.

Ben — can you help coordinate a slot that includes our SE? Connor is best for initial capacity sizing; if Connor can join we'll use the extra time to walk the sample workload end-to-end.

Jamie — if you have a preferred run-through agenda, send it over. Otherwise we propose:

1) 15 min run-of-show + discovery
2) 30 min technical sizing with SE (sample traffic and SLOs)
3) Next steps & MAP

Proposed alternative times (if 11/24 10:00 AM PT doesn't work):
- 11/24 1:00 PM PT
- 11/25 9:00 AM PT

Cheers,

Thanks Marissa & Ben — Connor, great to e-meet. 11/24 10am PT is tricky for a couple of our engs; 11/25 9:00 AM PT would be better.

To help the sizing conversation, a couple clarifications:
- The 120 QPS is sustained across a 4-hour business window (not bursts)
- Typical prompt length is ~380 tokens; responses average 420 tokens
- We have a cold-start pattern at start-of-hour that creates short spikes at ~200 QPS for 30s

I've attached a slightly expanded sample_workload.csv with per-minute counts (sample_workload.csv). Could Connor and the SE team look at that ahead of the call? We want to walk through suffix caching, KV cache behavior with streaming, and how you recommend quantization profiles for latency.

Jamie
